migrations.details: Name the exact formerly intended component columns. Existing min_datasets values, source paths, result artifacts and all business assertions remain unchanged.

migrations.details: Although these tests still rejected in the neighborhood run, add the original score-plus-component declarations so missing declaration does not mask the intended incomplete-source coverage path. Thresholds 2 and 3, output inputs, helper assertions and terminal rejection expectations are untouched.

migrations.classification: three declaration-only fixtures plus one explicit S3 rule version
migrations.details: The first three coverage functions only gain exact lists and retain their Assert AST. The old implicit-WER positive fallback now requires ValueError(dataset_coverage_not_declared). Its second negative branch gains dataset_keys=['score'] and retains the expected (False,0,1). The renamed function explicitly labels S3; the whole original function remains in the pinned Git blob.

migrations.classification: explicit S1-to-S3 live behavior versioning, not unchanged compatibility
details: Rename live selection/exception functions and parameter IDs to S3. Explicit ordered unique lists replace inferred WER/all-column membership and duplicate counting.
Invalid declared columns now expect stable ValueError(dataset_coverage_declaration_invalid), not the historical accidental AttributeError/TypeError.

Keep original archive arguments and expected archive values, including duplicate-input count behavior. For the live side only, pass a unique explicit declaration; the duplicate case's live expected count becomes 1 rather than 2.

Both architecture alias assertions and every literal Assert in this file remain AST-exact, but three parameter decorators and the exception guards change; no claim of full behavior or function-AST preservation is made.
No archive helper production changes or scientific authority are introduced.
